quote.text: sed quis custodiet ipsos custodes?” — but who will guard the guards themselves?
quote.author: Juvenal, Satire VI, lines 347–348

stories.headline: Eleven missing from a ship with three names
stories.dek: Four merchant vessels hit in eight days inside a NATO member’s waters. A day later the sunk one’s flag, owner and name are all still in dispute.

stories.kicker: The Atelier · Dehumidifiers And Air Treatment
stories.headline: The filter in the premium machine is labelled H12
stories.dek: Under the European standard H12 is not a HEPA class, and the headline claim is that class’s own threshold.

stories.headline: Intel printed a petaflops figure. Microsoft printed a percentage
stories.dek: Same summit, same Monday. One accelerator has an absolute peak and no price; the other has memory to four significant figures and no compute number at all.

stories.headline: The air is already enough to trigger the act
stories.dek: NEA says so itself. Four investigations opened after the 2015 haze are still open, and no prosecution has ever been completed since the law passed in 2014.

stories.kicker: The Kit · The Catalogue Without The Country
stories.headline: The catalogue is published here. The products are not
stories.dek: Apple’s Singapore newsroom carried nine new smart-home accessories on Tuesday. The availability line excludes Singapore from every one of them.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · The Livery Premium
stories.headline: Same watch, new colours, and not a limited edition
stories.dek: TAG Heuer marks ten years with Red Bull Racing at US$2,250. The plain version of the same watch trades unworn in Singapore at S$1,950.

stories.kicker: Culture Desk · Nine Hundred And Thirty-Five Dollars
stories.headline: A twenty-year-old subtitled fantasy out-earned it per screen
stories.dek: The Western we flagged on one Metacritic review now has its weekend. Two thousand two hundred screens returned $935 each, and Metacritic still has one review.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · The Window That Matters
stories.headline: Nothing at eleven. Something at twelve
stories.dek: A causal study of seven thousand adolescents modelled bedtime separately at each age. The effect appears only in the second window — and only on one kind of symptom.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The Real Yield Wins
stories.headline: Bonds fell with equities on nine days in ten
stories.dek: The global aggregate has lost 1.1 per cent this year while world equities made 13. On the ten worst equity days, the hedge showed up four times.

stories.kicker: The Rabbit Hole · Bookbinding And Book Repair
stories.headline: The tannery that supplies the world is eight people
stories.dek: Hand bookbinding has a subreddit growing at a quarter a year and no guild anywhere in Asia. Its best leather comes from a Scottish firm with a staff page you can count.

stories.kicker: Fitness · The Lab That Shares A Name
stories.headline: The ring was validated by a lab its maker co-owns
stories.dek: Forty-one adults, mean age twenty-six, against a discontinued research wristwatch — eight weeks after the maker was sued over its accuracy claims.

stories.headline: Eighteen sports, four days away, tickets still live
stories.dek: The Asian Para Games open on Saturday and have not sold out. Of eleven things on this page, nine publish no price at all.

stories.headline: Six point nine million children own the oil fund now
stories.dek: Astana credits half its sovereign fund’s investment income to named accounts for every child. Three years in, each holds $370.56 — and almost none of it moves.
